message.content:
Explore the Next.js codebase at /Users/jeffblankenburg/GitHub/devsassemble. I'm designing a click-through tracking feature for outbound links. Report concise findings with file paths + line numbers. Do NOT modify anything.

Answer these:

1. ANALYTICS ALREADY PRESENT: Search package.json and the code for any analytics/telemetry: `@vercel/analytics`, Vercel Web Analytics, PostHog, Plausible, Segment, Google Analytics, any custom "events"/"metrics"/"analytics" table or lib. Is anything installed and wired up (e.g. an <Analytics/> component in a layout)?

2. ADMIN AREA: List everything under app/admin/ — what pages exist, how they're laid out, and what a typical admin page looks like (read one representative page fully and summarize its structure: how it fetches data, how it's gated, the layout/components used).

3. ADMIN AUTH / CAPABILITIES: How is admin access gated? Find `requireCapability`, the capabilities model, and lib/auth/dal.ts. What capability names exist (e.g. 'moderate', 'manage_users')? How would I add a new capability or reuse an existing one for an analytics page?

4. EXISTING TABLES RELEVANT: Does the DB already have anything like page views, reactions, or event tracking I could learn the pattern from? Look at supabase/migrations for reactions (repo_reactions, tool_reactions) and any counting/aggregation patterns (triggers that maintain counts, like reply_count on topics).

5. OUTBOUND LINK RENDERING: Confirm how outbound links currently render — the LinkPreviewCard component (components/links/link-preview-card.tsx) and the Markdown component (components/markdown/markdown.tsx). Do any links already route through a redirect/tracking endpoint? Is there any app/r/ or app/api/click or similar?

6. ROUTE HANDLER PATTERN: Show the pattern for a simple GET route handler in this repo (e.g. app/api/events/slug-available/route.ts) so I know the conventions (how they read params, return responses).

Give me a tight structured summary, not file dumps.

93	      set reply_count = greatest(reply_count - 1, 0)
94	      where id = old.topic_id;
95	    return old;
96	  end if;
97	  return null;
98	end;
99	$$;

1	-- DevsAssemble — 0025 link previews (unfurled cards for discussion links)
2	-- When a member pastes a bare URL on its own line in a topic/reply, a cron-free
3	-- background job (next/after) fetches the page through the SSRF-safe fetcher and
4	-- caches the resolved Open Graph / oEmbed metadata here, keyed by normalized
5	-- URL. The discussion UI reads from this cache — a cache miss renders a plain
6	-- link until the row lands. The preview image is re-hosted into a dedicated
7	-- bucket (never hot-linked), so image_path is this row's own cleanup ledger.
8	-- Public read (all content is public); writes only via the service-key client.
9	-- Reuses set_updated_at() from 0001.
10	
11	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
12	-- Cache table
13	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
14	create table public.link_previews (
15	  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
16	  url         text unique not null,                  -- normalized source URL (the cache key)
17	  status      text not null default 'pending'
18	                check (status in ('pending', 'ok', 'error')),
19	  kind        text not null default 'link'
20	                check (kind in ('link', 'article', 'video')),
21	  provider    text,                                   -- 'opengraph' | 'youtube' | ...
22	  title       text,
23	  description text,
24	  site_name   text,
25	  author      text,                                   -- channel/byline (video author, etc.)
26	  image_url   text,                                   -- our re-hosted public image URL
27	  image_path  text,                                   -- object path in link-preview-images (cleanup ledger)
28	  error       text,                                   -- last failure reason when status = 'error'
29	  fetched_at  timestamptz,                            -- when metadata was last resolved
30	  created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
31	  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now()
32	);
33	
34	comment on table public.link_previews is
35	  'Cache of unfurled link metadata keyed by normalized URL. Populated by a background job after a post is created; read by the discussion UI.';
36	
37	create trigger link_previews_set_updated_at
38	  before update on public.link_previews
39	  for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();
40	
41	-- The sweep refreshes the oldest-resolved rows; this index serves that scan.
42	create index link_previews_fetched_at_idx
43	  on public.link_previews (fetched_at);
44	
45	alter table public.link_previews enable row level security;
46	
47	-- Public read: previews decorate public discussion content.
48	create policy "link_previews_public_read"
49	  on public.link_previews for select
50	  using (true);
51	
52	-- No insert/update/delete policies: unfurling is server-only and runs through
53	-- the secret-key client, which bypasses RLS. This keeps members from writing
54	-- arbitrary preview rows (which would otherwise be a self-XSS / spoofing vector).
55	
56	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	-- Storage bucket for re-hosted preview images
58	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
60	values ('link-preview-images', 'link-preview-images', true)
61	on conflict (id) do nothing;
62	
63	create policy "link_preview_images_public_read"
64	  on storage.objects for select
65	  using (bucket_id = 'link-preview-images');
66	
67	-- No member write policies: images are downloaded + uploaded exclusively by the
68	-- service-key client during unfurling, which bypasses RLS.
